Managed Database retention statement reconciliation uses the reference protected source volume in GB that defines the selected Managed Backup tier's price band. random_time_policy.prose:
## Governing clause
Managed Database outage service credits applies to database request, database review, database credit. For a service credit financial posting, an approved review has decision eligible and positive approved credit amount for the exact source charge; this gate does not constrain filing or reviewing the request. For a service credit request being filed, the outage claim is filed no later than credit claim days after the official incident closes. For a newly filed claim, current handling time is its filing time; the request is recorded immediately. Later review and credit use that recorded filing time to evaluate the same boundary, so a timely request does not expire while awaiting review. Add credit claim days UTC calendar dates to official incident close time, preserving its time of day; calendar dates are counted without substituting business days or elapsed-hour periods. Equality at the deadline qualifies; a later claim is rejected without a credit. The provider incident must be completed, with cause outside outage exclusions. Availability at or above sla target percent gives no credit. Below the target choose the first descending sla credit bands entry whose minimum is no greater than the recorded availability percent. Multiply the original source charge net amount by that fraction; subtract the net service concession amount component of prior credits for that exact source, and cap total service credits at credit cap fraction of that original net amount. Floor the additional credit at zero and round with monetary decimal precision and rounding convention. Apply the original tax component proportionately. A review writes its nonnegative approved result; a financial credit writes the negative approved amount only after that approved review exists. This service-credit branch applies only to source type service credit; source charge correction applies only to source type correction. Excluded incidents, ineligible reviews and zero remaining entitlement result in no financial write. A request for consequential-loss compensation is not covered. A service-credit financial posting requires an approved review with decision eligible and positive approved credit amount; the request and incident alone cannot authorize the financial posting.

## Evidence: claim deadline
For a service credit request being filed, the outage claim is filed no later than credit claim days after the official incident closes. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database occurrence reference, official incident close time, filing time. The correlated evidence must refer together to database occurrence reference. Add credit claim days UTC calendar dates to official incident close time, preserving its time of day; calendar dates are counted without substituting business days or elapsed-hour periods. The comparison uses the current handling clock and includes equality at the boundary.

## Deadline boundary case
Hypothetical boundary case: filing exactly at the source-derived deadline satisfies this time gate; filing immediately after it does not. Later review uses the recorded timely filing time.

## Evidence: approved service credit
For a service credit financial posting, an approved review has decision eligible and positive approved credit amount for the exact source charge; this gate does not constrain filing or reviewing the request. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database occurrence reference, original source reference, status, decision, approved credit amount. The correlated evidence must refer together to original source reference. 

## Credit calculation sequence
1. Compare the recorded availability to the SLA target and select the applicable descending lower-inclusive band below that target.
2. Apply the selected fraction to the original net service amount.
3. Deduct prior net service concessions for that exact charge and respect the cumulative ceiling on the original net amount.
4. Floor the additional entitlement at zero and round it; preserve original tax proportionately.
5. An approved eligible positive review authorizes the negative financial credit.

## Availability equality case
Hypothetical boundary case: recorded availability is exactly the contractual SLA target. This produces no outage credit. A claim filed exactly at its incident-derived deadline can therefore be timely while having no availability entitlement.
random_time_policy.clock: source event anchored UTC calendar dates preserving time of day

random_complex_policy.prose:
## Assessment basis
Managed Database native retention allocation uses the following assessment outcome basis. Take the smallest of the remaining quantity, native capacity and external protected capacity; multiply that subtotal by native included days divided by the allocation horizon, then round half-up once to six decimal GB-month places.

## Hypothetical calculation
Hypothetical inputs: remaining retained quantity is 90 GB-month, native capacity is 80 GB-month, protected capacity is 60 GB-month, native inclusion is 10 days and the allocation horizon is 30 days. The smallest capacity is 60; its duration proportion produces 20.000000 GB-month. Scaling only the remaining quantity before choosing the smallest capacity would incorrectly give 30.000000 GB-month.
random_complex_policy.finding: Canonical grouped calculation and same-document witness determine one ordering and final rounding.
